task: Design and validate a fixed-output-lattice boundary-window solver that uses adaptive interval samples only as collocation constraints.
scope_guards: Do not modify production add-on code, releases, source animation, authored pins, qualification thresholds, sealed confirmation clips or data splits.
Keep adaptive samples as constraints only; do not serialize them as output keys.
Reject any spatial pass that creates a temporal regression between evaluation samples.
validation_required: Use the unchanged final COM, contact and orientation gates.
Measure quaternion speed and acceleration over every output interval and compare with the retained grouped baseline.
Record production hashes and limitations; do not promote from one artificial BoneForge jump.
